references.text: God tells Abraham that nothing is too hard for the Lord, in connection with the promise that Sarah will bear a son.
The Lord is with the righteous, and nothing is impossible with His help.
Jeremiah proclaims that nothing is too hard for the Lord.
Jesus says that for people this is impossible, but for God all things are possible.
Jesus emphasizes that for people it is impossible, but not for God; for all things are possible for God.
What is impossible for people is possible for God.
